answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose secret is distributed through Shamir shares bound to Semaphore identities and RLN nullifiers. A valid message proves membership without revealing identity; two messages from one rate-limited identity expose a polynomial collision, reconstructing the private key from shares and triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. This deters Sybil clones across comet, terrace, and juniper channels.
